name: Owner contacts, built from scratch
summary: Builds the agency's owner contact list from VaultRE's current owners, checks each owner's recorded email consent and do-not-call flag, and drafts an outreach email to owners who may be contacted. Crons read and draft; a person approves every email send.

covered_by.verify-details: skill (identity check done by hand; no mapped platform)
covered_by.consent-check: consent-check (VaultRE GDPR record and do-not-call flag)
covered_by.campaign-outreach: outreach (email draft, send queued for approval)

crons.name: owner-list
crons.summary: Add owners from VaultRE's current owners list that the workflow has not seen.

crons.name: consent-check
crons.summary: Read each new owner's VaultRE record and consent flags; mark each eligible, no-consent or blocked.

crons.name: outreach
crons.summary: Re-check eligible owners, draft an email to each one still eligible, and queue its send for approval (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads of VaultRE owner and consent records, and an Outlook draft. Sending the draft is a live operation and waits for a person.

vaultre.covers: current owners, owner contact details, GDPR consent records, do-not-call flag

microsoft-365.covers: outreach email draft and its approved send from the agency mailbox

gaps: Identity or credit check on an owner (the ID screen in the call): no mapped platform operation. Done by hand before any owner is worked.
Do-not-call register check: no mapped operation. The workflow never places a call; it only reads VaultRE's onDoNotCallList flag.

Text (SMS) outreach to owners who were never contacted first: not built. The call said a reply counts as consent, and the kit does not accept that. SMS waits until VaultRE's SMS consent flag is confirmed as the consent record.
The platform evidence file for this workflow is missing, so platform support comes from the kit's mapped operations only.
Both adapters are docs-only until a VaultRE sandbox account and a Microsoft 365 developer tenant prove them. The Microsoft 365 token flow is not built; a Graph access token must be supplied.
